verdict.rationale: Figma docs describe a built-in "Figma agent" that can generate new design directions, edit images, create diagrams, and search files (figma-docs-17, figma-docs-34), plus paid AI credits for team use (figma-docs-24), showing some in-editor AI asset handling. However, there's no specific documentation of background removal, content-aware fill, or copy/text suggestion tools, and community feedback flags Figma's AI features (in FigJam) as "really bad and often broken" (figma-comm-8), undercutting confidence in polish. Missing for 10: explicit background-removal feature, content-aware fill feature, copy-suggestion feature, and independent hands-on validation of AI image tools working reliably.
